reason: BWP-LIVE-001 B2 hardens the existing capital-guard config parsers in place: guard flags (live_canary_allowed, owner_caps_ratified, scale_in_forbidden, automatic_retry_forbidden, full_core_guard_join_enabled) accept only JSON booleans (the string "false" previously ratified owner caps and enabled the full-core join via bool()), and decimal caps reject non-finite values (Infinity/NaN previously accepted). The protected-surface content pin binds the exact new capital-guard content to the owner offline-implementation GO.
